'''Volume 4''' is the fourth volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of [[Shogakukan]]'s collected releases of the magazine version.

==Blurb==
''Casey and Henry’s journey through the Galar region continues! Casey is finally reunited with another of her missing Pokémon! Will she be able to find all of them?''

''And can Henry win the challenge against Allister?!''
